open.title: Flash-forward opener
open.finding: Open on the peak, tag the jump, rewind, then play the edit. A plain opening loses the scroll.

evidence.what: stop-scroll score, helicopter edit, first 1.5 s
evidence.how: a model judge shown both openings frame by frame (every 0.15 s), asked twice with A and B swapped; scores averaged
evidence.more: held-out edit (N3on dunk): 7 vs 4. The shipped version adds a ▶▶ 14 SEC LATER tag; it then beat this one 6.5 vs 6.

open.title: Crisp slow-mo
open.finding: Where optical flow can't follow a spin, hold real frames on threes instead of inventing in-betweens.

evidence.what: crispness score on the helicopter spin (12-frame window at 5.10 s)
evidence.how: a model judge on a 300 px crop of the action, both A/B orders
evidence.more: ghosted frames per 12: 5-6 → 0-2. Across 8 peak windows of 4 edits crisp won 4 in both orders, split 4, lost 0.

after.label: after: real frames held on threes

open.note: cropped 1.5x to the action; both sides identical except the frames

open.title: House-style hook
open.finding: One hook formula (who + what + one CAPS word + one emoji, 10 words max) and one caption family, checked in code.

evidence.what: stop-scroll score, Kai "plate" edit, first 2 s
evidence.how: a model judge, both A/B orders (the two numbers are the two orders)
evidence.more: text over faces: 10 sampled frames → 0. Over six edits the house text won 11 of 12 judge rounds, split 1, lost 0.
